scope: Previously verified three full calendars, Qwen3-8B model arms plus saved program scores

bay2024.gate: absent in all audited model configs; no uncalled gate candidates imputed

front2024.gate: absent in all audited model configs; no uncalled gate candidates imputed

front2026.gate: absent in all audited model configs; no uncalled gate candidates imputed

denominators.registered_opportunities: Sum over arms/sessions, not independent weather cases
denominators.predictor_calls: Actual saved predictor outputs, excludes selector calls
denominators.recorded_candidates: One engine candidate event per actual predictor call, including follow/no_change and invalid responses
denominators.accepted_candidates: Accepted engine override events; not necessarily nonbaseline or present at a cutoff
denominators.snapshots: One per declared opportunity; overrides may persist from calls addressing another lead

static_candidate_gain_scope: Evaluator-only comparison of each actually returned probability with the base at its call start, regardless of decision. It ignores subsequent time/versions and is not an end-to-end policy score.
selector_selection_limitation: Trace records successful calls and selector outputs but not every hypothetical skipped candidate. Uncalled probabilities and reasons for every unselected opportunity remain unavailable.
